title: Questions to ask your partner about their childhood

slides.title: Questions to ask your partner *about their childhood*
What was your favorite *cartoon* growing up?
What did you *get in trouble* for the most?
Who was your *best friend* at school?
What did your family do *on weekends?*
What would you tell *your younger self?*
Save this *for a nostalgic night.*
slides.sub: Old photos make it even better.
